channel.title: Tuned blog
channel.description: News, guides and what's new in Tuned.

item.title: How many devices can I use IPTV on? Connections explained
item.description: Your IPTV plan counts streams playing at once, not devices. What a connection is, what uses one, why you get blocked, and how to watch on several TVs without going over.

item.title: How to watch your IPTV playlist on a Samsung or LG TV
item.description: Samsung and LG TVs don't run Android apps, but you can still watch your own playlist on them. Cast from your phone, or add a small streaming box. Step by step.

item.title: IPTV not working? A 10-step fix list
item.description: Channels won't load, a stream won't start, the guide is empty or everything buffers. Ten checks, in order, that fix most IPTV problems on Android phones and TVs.

item.title: M3U, Xtream Codes or MAC portal: which should you use?
item.description: Your provider may offer an M3U link, an Xtream Codes login or a MAC portal. What each one is, what you get with it, and which to pick in your player.

item.title: Parental controls for IPTV: kids profiles, PINs and hiding adult channels
item.description: Big IPTV playlists come with adult categories and thousands of channels. How to hide adult content behind a PIN, make a kids profile, and lock profiles in Tuned.

item.title: The best free IPTV player with no ads
item.description: Which IPTV players are really free, which show ads, and which stop after a trial. A plain table of popular players, and what you get free in Tuned.

item.title: The best IPTV Smarters alternatives for Android phones and TVs
item.description: Want something other than IPTV Smarters Pro? What to look for in a replacement, the players worth trying, and how to move your login over in minutes.

item.title: Track what you watch from your IPTV playlist with Trakt and Simkl
item.description: Connect Trakt or Simkl to Tuned and every film and episode you watch from your playlist lands in your history, on every device. Import what you've already watched, too.

item.title: Watch on a plane: download films and shows from your IPTV playlist
item.description: Save films, episodes and whole seasons from your own IPTV playlist to your phone or tablet, and watch them on a plane, a train or anywhere without internet.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.17.0
item.description: Tuned 2.17.0 is out. New accounts get Getting to know Tuned, a short daily email about one feature at a time, which you can turn off in your account.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.16.1
item.description: Tuned 2.16.1, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Signing in on a TV with your phone now opens Tuned straight away on copies from Google Play.

item.title: How to install Tuned on a Fire TV Stick or Fire TV Cube
item.description: Install Tuned on a Fire TV Stick, Stick 4K Max or Fire TV Cube with the free Downloader app, check whether your model can install apps at all, and set it up from your phone.

item.title: How to set up IPTV on your TV, step by step
item.description: Everything you need to watch your IPTV playlist on a TV, from the box and the player to adding the playlist and the TV guide, with pictures of every step.

item.title: Is IPTV legal? What a player does, and what to check before you pay a provider
item.description: IPTV is a way of sending TV over the internet, not a kind of piracy. Here's the difference between a player and a provider, and the warning signs to check before you pay for a playlist.

item.title: Never miss a game: today's events, teams you follow and alerts
item.description: Find tonight's games and fights in your own IPTV playlist without scrolling through dozens of event channels, follow your teams, and get a tap-to-watch alert before kick-off.

item.title: Pause, rewind and record live TV on Android, no DVR box needed
item.description: Turn your IPTV playlist's live channels into something you can pause, rewind up to an hour and record, on one connection, with no cloud DVR or extra box.

item.title: Switching from TiviMate or IPTV Smarters to Tuned in 5 minutes
item.description: Moving to a new IPTV player is quicker than you think. Bring the same login or link, your guide and your favourite channels, and set Tuned up the way you like it.

item.title: The best IPTV player for Android phones in 2026
item.description: What makes a good IPTV app on an Android phone, from instant start and a real TV guide to casting and downloads, and how Tuned does each.

item.title: The best streaming box for IPTV in 2026
item.description: Which Android TV or Google TV box to buy for your IPTV playlist, what actually matters (Ethernet, frame rate matching, memory, sound), and the settings to change on day one.

item.title: Your channels and TV guide on your computer
item.description: Browse your IPTV playlist's full grid guide in a web browser, filter it like the app, and open any channel in VLC on your Mac, PC, iPhone or Android, straight from your provider.
